title: Local open arrow and one-input support identification
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, B a family of coefficient categories on its six-functor spaces, S a push stage, T its curried tensors, Q a compactified square, and A a SixFunctorExchangeData S T Q [def-sf-operation-stages]. For K in B(Q.X) and L in B(Q.Y), define openMap(A,K,L) from tensorBar(openExtension K,properPull L) to openExtension(T_X(K,S.pull Q.f L)) as the given openProjection component followed by openExtension of the equality transport from A.tensorX and A.pull. Define supportMap(A,K) from properPush(openExtension K) to S.support(Q.f,Q.compactification)(K) as inverse compactSupportIdentification followed by the equality transport from A.compactSupport. Both are explicit composites. Naturality of the inverse support identification gives second(A,K,L) [def-sf-integral-projection-factor-data] = properPush.map(openMap(A,K,L)) followed by supportMap(A,T_X(K,S.pull Q.f L)).

source.place: Compactification-independence sentence: compatibility of individual refinement maps with counits and j_!, before the projection square is deduced. Integral-system realization steps 1 and 3 of lem-sf-integral-projection-refinement-square.

proof.text: Construct the two maps by the displayed composites of the supplied projection and support maps and equality transports. For the identity second_via_openMap, use naturality of inverse compactSupportIdentification on the input equality transport. Apply properPush functoriality, then combine equality transports by eqToHom_map and eqToHom_trans. This gives exactly the original second, including its final transport. This construction is independent of coefficient reduction and introduces no chosen witness.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility with counits and j_!, together with naturality; explicit generic factorization before coefficient change, U9.
